turns.q: How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
turns.replyTail:
get the best result?
To get the best results from your cold plunge, a great starting goal is aim for 11 minutes total per week, split into sessions of 2 to 3 minutes at a time.
Start at a comfortable temperature (around 50°F–55°F) and focus on slow, controlled breathing to calm your nervous system. As you build tolerance, you can gradually lower the temperature down toward 37°F–45°F.
